about_the_game:
Secretly live in a stranger’s house, stalk your new family, and survive without getting caught.

They don’t know you exist—but to you, they are family.

In My Stranger Family, you step into the shoes of a mysterious intruder. Follow the story of a family that knows nothing about your presence. Try to survive—find food, sneak into rooms, and make it through the night without raising suspicion. Every move you make matters.

Stealth and Strategy

Sneak around the house without being seen. Stay hidden as you observe the family’s daily routines and use the environment to your advantage. Explore their home and blend into their world—without them ever knowing.

Survival Mechanics

Your needs and health matter. Eat well, rest up, and take care of yourself while living with your new family. Maintain your health to stay alive. Every decision you make affects your survival.

Chores & Cleaning

Keep the house tidy without drawing attention. Clean up messes, organize items, and make sure everything is in its place, because a messy home could raise suspicion.

Dynamic Family Behavior

Observe the family’s daily life. Each member has their own routine, and it’s up to you to figure out how and when to interact with them.

Open-Ended Gameplay

With sandbox-style freedom, you can choose how to approach every situation. Interact with objects and experiment with different ways to survive. The house is yours to explore.

Protect Your Family in Secret

They don't know you exist, but that doesn't mean you don’t care. Keep them safe from the shadows, watching over your family without ever revealing yourself.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes, including violence, dark humor, suggestive content, and unsettling situations. Viewer discretion is advised.
